Tongji.anomalies_detected: Identity swapping/shift affecting 110/600 classes (18.3%) resolved via Hungarian alignment.

coordinate_collapse.definition: A geometric degeneration in angular metric spaces (like cosine similarity) when unconstrained non-uniform scaling (min-max normalization) is applied to embeddings. The metric tensor becomes ill-conditioned, causing projections to cluster along a single dominant coordinate axis.

condition_number_divergence.implication: Reduces matching space dimensionality from k to 1, destroying discriminative information.

mitigation_residual_calibration.implication: Restricts deformation, preventing collapse while emphasizing high-utility biometric features.
